name: Pokémon Hero
summary:
Pokémon Hero is an original Pokémon adventure beyond gym leaders, featuring a cast of characters who may see you as a hero or villain based on your actions. It includes Pokémon from all generations, adaptive enemies across three difficulty levels, and mandatory and optional bosses.
Scripted battles add strategy and narrative, while Zorua illusion zones reveal hidden treasures and mysteries. Explore an extensive map with Ultraflight, complete missions and achievements, and take on riddles and challenges alongside extras like Pokémon following you and route-based Pokémon tracking.
